title: COUNT EVIDENCE, NOT SENTENCES: TEMPERED EVIDENCE FUSION OF LLM JUDGMENTS FOR LONG-TEXT VALUE MEASUREMENT
reasoning: The paper introduces the MIND benchmark for evaluating how LLMs measure public value orientations. The dataset spans several value systems and normative dimensions, explicitly including 'Ethical Liberalism vs. Ethical Conservatism', 'Equality of Opportunity vs. Equality of Outcome', and 'Substantive Justice vs. Procedural Justice', which clearly fall under ethical frameworks, value pluralism, and societal morality.
